image_description: A small guenon monkey sitting inside a wire cage. The monkey has grey fur on its back and limbs, with lighter cream/white fur on its chest and underside. It is viewed in profile through the vertical bars of the cage. The face is partially visible, showing a dark muzzle and light facial hair. The tail is curled around the body.

The profile view shows a distinct, narrow snout typical of guenons, visible between the cage bars.
One ear is clearly visible, appearing small and rounded with pinkish skin, consistent with the species.
